messages.content: I have the Baltimore project code now: BAL-DEINST-820. There is also a schedule change. Tuesday's museum call is 7:30 a.m., so I need to fly up Monday evening. Please check the Monday flight and tell me whether Wednesday night is still sensible after the crates leave at 5:00.

The Monday nonstop previously discussed still works: Atlanta to BWI on Monday, August 18, departing at 6:35 p.m. and arriving at 8:27 p.m. For Wednesday, I found two nonstop returns worth comparing: one at 7:20 p.m., arriving Atlanta at 9:14 p.m., and the later flight at 8:45 p.m., arriving at 10:39 p.m. I am checking both against the museum-to-hotel-to-airport sequence.
Assume the crates actually pull away at 5:00, not that I can leave before then. My carry-on will be at the hotel near the Walters.

With a 5:00 p.m. crate departure, closeout and handoff would likely keep you at the museum until about 5:15. Allowing 10 to 15 minutes to reach the hotel and retrieve the bag puts departure for BWI around 5:30. The drive is commonly 25 to 40 minutes at that hour, so a realistic airport arrival is approximately 6:00 to 6:15 p.m., with 6:30 possible if traffic or closeout runs long.
That makes 7:20 look too close. Is the 8:45 flight Delta?

Yes. The 8:45 p.m. nonstop is Delta, arriving in Atlanta at 10:39 p.m. The 7:20 p.m. option is another carrier. The Delta return leaves roughly two hours and fifteen minutes after a conservative 6:30 airport arrival, while the earlier flight would leave only 50 minutes later.
That flight is also Delta and nonstop, arriving BWI at 8:27 p.m. The round trip using the Monday 6:35 outbound and Wednesday 8:45 return is still $276 in the quoted main-cabin fare.
Good. Delta fits the schedule and the price is fine, so use that pairing. I do not want to add Thursday just to avoid getting home late.

Understood. I will use the Delta nonstop Monday evening and the later Delta nonstop Wednesday. The Wednesday timing preserves a workable airport margin after the 5:00 p.m. crate departure, so there is no need to retain Thursday as the planned return.
Before you ticket it, confirm the sequence Wednesday one more time. I do not want the itinerary resting on a best-case drive.

Conservative Wednesday sequence: crates depart at 5:00 p.m.; finish the handoff and leave the Walters around 5:15; reach the nearby hotel and collect the carry-on by about 5:30; depart immediately for BWI; arrive around 6:10 under ordinary traffic, with 6:30 as the working delay case. That still leaves 2 hours 15 minutes before the 8:45 departure. A disruption beyond that could reduce the cushion, but the plan does not depend on the fastest drive.
That is realistic. Book the round trip to BAL-DEINST-820. Keep the hotel at two nights; I will choose the property separately.

Booked under project code BAL-DEINST-820: Delta nonstop from Atlanta to BWI on Monday, August 18, departing at 6:35 p.m. and arriving at 8:27 p.m.; Delta nonstop from BWI to Atlanta on Wednesday, August 20, departing at 8:45 p.m. and arriving at 10:39 p.m. Total airfare is $276. Flight confirmation: DL8M4R. The Wednesday return is based on leaving the museum after the 5:00 p.m. crate departure, retrieving the carry-on near the Walters, and targeting BWI by 6:10 to 6:30 p.m. Thursday is no longer being held as the return option. The lodging plan remains two nights, Monday and Tuesday, with Wednesday luggage storage; no hotel has been selected or booked.
